_why: UIV-B1: the arrival platforms the c4-c6 jumps place (UIV-S0-2, S0-4). One row per place; the controller faces north and the 15 x 15 ring runs to +z. The front wall carries the ring's parts; the wireless pair and the AE2 seed stand beside the ring.

platforms._why: UXV-B1: the c8 and c9 jumps leave from Cygnus X-1's orbit (server_scripts/grindless/uxv/kerr_sling.js places these two)
OpV-F1: the c11 and c12 jumps leave from Cygnus X-1's orbit too (server_scripts/grindless/uxv/kerr_sling.js places every row with a source); their gate rows are OpV-A0's and OpV-R1's
MAX-F1: the c14 jump leaves from Cygnus X-1's orbit to Sgr A* (gcyr:black_hole_orbit); the c15 jump to the NSC belt leaves from Sgr A*'s orbit. Their gate rows are MAX-G1's
